data.ruling: The refutation does not stand. BSC014N04LSATMA1 stays for "servo rail gate". The stock verifier confirmed the part and raised no refutation. Its one disagreeing check, market introduction, was stated as "not read" and read as 2012-10-11. That is 14.0 years on the market, against the 12-month flag, and the check passes. The datasheet verifier's one failed check is "ambient temperature". I re-read it. Rev. 2.9 (2024-06-11), Table 2, gives the operating and storage temperature Tj, Tstg as -55 to 175 degC. Line 2.9 of the revision history reads "Upgrade Operating and storage temperature max to 175°C". The stated "Tj -55 to 150 degC" is therefore the figure of an earlier revision and is wrong for the datasheet in force. The error is on the conservative side: 150 degC is lower than 175 degC. The requirement is the board's 0 to 50 degC ambient (V7, owner, 2026-09-28: one range for the whole IO board). That range lies inside both ratings. The verifier recorded passes true for this check. This follows the ruling on INA3221AIRGVR in FU-2B2, adjudicator-R8-3, where a wrong figure that still met the requirement corrected the record and did not refute the part. A refuted report entry differs, because there the figure is the deliverable. Here the part meets every requirement value. The correction to the record is Tj, Tstg -55 to 175 degC (Rev. 2.9, Table 2). Nothing in this ruling concerns the part's lifecycle, end-of-life notices, maker allowlist or LCSC identity. Its subject is a figure checked against this function's requirement, so the scope is function. This ruling re-read only the temperature evidence and the V7 requirement. The other 9 datasheet checks and all 13 stock and lifecycle checks agree and pass, as the verifiers report.
